讚美之泉
詞：鄭懋柔／曲：游智婷

lines.a: 我屬於祢 祢是我永遠的福分
lines.b: Lord, I am Yours, You are my portion evermore

lines.a: 只想日夜在祢殿中獻上敬拜
lines.b: Every night and day, here in Your court, I worship

lines.a: 定睛在祢的榮美 世上一切變暗淡
lines.b: Let me gaze upon Your face, all else will fade away

lines.a: 除祢以外 我還能有誰
lines.b: There’s no one else for me but You

lines.a: 能不能 就讓我留在祢的同在裡
lines.b: Let me stay, I want to stay right here in Your embrace

lines.a: 能不能 賜我力量讓我更多愛祢
lines.b: Let me stay, give me the strength to love You more each day

lines.a: 我哪都不想去 只想日夜在祢殿中
lines.b: There is no other place I would rather be than here, Lord

lines.a: 獻上敬拜 全心全意來愛祢
lines.b: With all my heart, with all I am, I worship

lines.a: 獻上敬拜 全心全意來愛祢
lines.b: With all my heart, with all I am, I worship
